description: Election Commission -  Declare that M. N. M. Nawsar as a member of the Attanagalla P/S
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Attanagalla Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
